title: Earth's City Lights by DMSP, 1994–1995
author: NASA Goddard / NOAA Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (composite by C. Mayhew & R. Simmon)
alt_text: Satellite composite of Earth at night: continents traced in electric light, with vast dark regions across central Africa and south Asia — a map of who received an electrification campaign and who did not.
